observations.originalSourceNotes: Bloomberg previously reported that OpenAI had exceeded $40B in annualized revenue in August. However, a later FT report provided further context that the $40B figure was the result of an investor analysis grossing up OpenAI's revenue to include cloud provider revenue that wasn't shared with OpenAI. FT reported that OpenAI was near 30bn annualized in July.
